Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these cough and shortness of breath symptoms?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: No acute infiltrates or consolidation. Mild bronchial wall thickening.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the results. The clear lungs suggest this isn't pneumonia, but the thickening hints at chronic irritation. Have you noticed any wheezing, coughing up phlegm, or symptoms worsening at night or with exercise?

speaker: Patient
text: Yes, I do hear a whistling sound when I breathe hard, and I have noticed a few episodes of coughing up clear mucus. My cough and shortness of breath seem to get much worse right before bed and whenever I start working hard. However, hospital policy during the current surge is to avoid non-essential labs. Cardiac diagnosis must be made from clinical evaluation only.
